{{Quote|I knew you'd be coming back this way as soon as I heard you had your hands on this YT-2400. So I've got some appropriately 'hot' components we can load up. First we'll strip down the shield generators, install some power loop capacitors and reconstruct the entire array system.|[[Bolabo Hujaan]], to [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]]|<ref name="All the Extras">{{WEGCite|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook|story=All the Extras}}</ref>}}
A '''power loop capacitor''' was an energy transferal device. The [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] [[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']] was modified with power loop capacitors, which boosted the power of the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]] by redirecting energy from the ''Outrider''{{'s}} [[Power core/Legends|power core]].
